name: harness-builder
description: Builds, audits, and repairs a project's agent harness layer by layer — environment and sandbox, knowledge base and routing, hard-boundary gates, authority boundary, spec-driven completion criteria, and entropy management — with spec-driven development skills for OpenSpec, Spec-Kit, and lightweight specs.
